html_source: Map of a 69 Hz wave in a cylinder of air with the 33.7m diameter of the St. Paul's whispering gallery, created at the Applied Solid State Physics Laboratory of Hokkaido University Sapporo, Japan in 2012, with red and blue representing higher and lower air pressures, and distortion in the grid lines representing air particle displacements. Source: Wikimedia Commons.
